senses.gloss: m. ch. = חֲצָב B. Bath. 56ᵃ ח׳ שבו תיחם וכ׳ (Ms. O. חצב, Rashi חצובה) it is the ḥ. which Joshua introduced as landmarks.
units: Bets. 25ᵇ ח׳ מקטע וכ׳ (some ed. חצובה) the ḥ. cuts the feet of (convicts) the wicked (who remove the boundary lines).—
Pes. 111ᵇ בטולא דחצבא דלא חצב גרמידא (Rashi: דחצובא) in the shade of a ḥ that has not cut through (grown) to an arm’s length (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Yalk. Deut. 945.
